category_title: Confident students seeking agency through co-teaching
minimal_context: The student is listening to the teacher disseminate science content from the lesson plan.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please look at the lesson plan on the board. We are going to go over the science content for today. I will read the definitions, and you need to listen and copy them down.

STUDENT: I'm looking at it, but I don't really get it. We do not always understand the content when the science teacher teaches it just by reading it out loud.

TUTOR: Just listen carefully while I explain the steps.

STUDENT: But you explain things but you're not putting anything into it. If I was teaching, I'd explain it using conditions that we can actually understand.

TUTOR: Let's just stick to the lesson plan for now and keep going.

STUDENT: It's not working though. Sometimes we would get confused because it doesn't connect to us. It needs to be like us helping us, so we can actually learn it.

options.A: Incorporate relationship-building components during the science lesson, such as a pleasant voice tone, neutral facial expressions, and a relaxed body posture.
options.B: Enforce medication compliance and implement structured behavioral programming for the student during the delivery of the science lesson plan.
options.C: Perform a quick review of the science lesson plan with the student as a co-teacher to ensure the content is reflected accurately.
options.D: Review antecedent data from the science lesson to create a hypothesis statement that includes the perceived reason for the student's behavior.
